jobs_results.title: Data Scientist MLCore Team – Data Science & BI (Openbank)
jobs_results.description:
Country: Spain

Data Scientist MLCore Team – Data Science & BI (Openbank)

We are the 100% digital bank of the Santander Group and we are currently undergoing a technological transformation and international expansion process. In 2017, we kicked off our relaunch plans and have been continuously expanding and growing ever since, especially when it comes to technology. We work in a start-up format, using agile methodologies to take our customers' experience to the next level. In 2019, we launched in the Netherlands, Germany and Portugal, with other countries currently in the pipeline.

Our culture sets us apart from the rest; social and diversity clubs are part of our essence and day-to-day culture.

Mission and responsibilities:

As a Data Scientist, your mission will be to provide the link between the pure commercial business needs with the analytical engines, creating the link between business areas and a team of data scientists. In particular, Openbank’s Data Science - MLCore which... is responsible for the ideation, development, maintenance and monitoring of machine learning models applied to business units (mainly Risk & Cybersecurity). It also develops methodological tools for the analysis and exploitation of information.

Within the Data Science - MLCore team we go beyond optimizing the ROC-AUC curve; we expect you to have experience applying ML algorithms and engines to solve Business problems and take data-driven decisions.

For this role you need to have at least 3 years of proven experience in an industrial environment.
• You think out of the box, you like to continuously think and propose new points of improvement for models.
• You love to learn and dig into rigorous analysis, but you are a problem solver that needs to understand the problem to solve.
• You enjoy never-faced challenges and data sources.
• You have interest in learning from other Data Science experts, using feedback to improve analysis and understanding of strategies.
• You can explain complex topics to a diverse range of audiences.
• You feel comfortable with Scikit-learn, and sometimes you complement it with your own developments / functionalities.
• You feel comfortable participating in the development of scalable solutions and productizing; however, we have a ML-Operations team that will support you in achieving technical excellence.

To be successful in the role you must have
• Software development:
• You know git and feel comfortable using it, and how to develop your own code, test it and use it to produce actionable results.
• You are able to produce functional code beyond Jupyter Notebooks.
• Programming skills for data analytics. Knowledge of Python and Spark. Some experience in object-oriented programming is desirable.
• You know the basics of SQL and you are able to query essential information from multiple tables.
• Statistical modelling and machine learning:
• You have some experience with supervised and unsupervised problems.
• You have experience with binary classification problems, and you know standard ML methods.
• You know the difference between a random forest and k-means and know how to implement them.
• You know how to tune their hyperparameters in order to avoid overfitting/underfitting.
• You know different model evaluation metrics, and when one is preferred versus others.
• You have worked with problems from the beginning to the end of the process.

What do we offer?
• Joining a dynamic and agile company undergoing international expansion.
• Working in start-up mode with the support of the Santander Group.
• Competitive remuneration and attractive benefits package.
• Possibility of growth within the company and the Group.
• Collaborating on international projects in different countries.
• Excellent work environment, social clubs and frequent events (virtual at present).

Would you like to grow with us? Join our team!

Openbank is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered as equal without paying attention to gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, age, political orientation, union membership nor disability status.

We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

If you´re not currently living in Madrid or Valencia and you are open to relocate yourself, we would still love to consider your application

The personal data you provide as well as any data generated during the selection process are confidential and will be processed by Open Bank, S.A./ Open Digital Services, S.L. with registered office at Plaza de Santa Bárbara 2, 28004 (Madrid), for the sole purpose of managing your participation in the selection processes and, where appropriate, to formalise your recruitment. 

For further information about your rights and data protection, please read the ODS/Openbank Privacy Policy applicable to this type of data processing here

Position Description

Únete a CGI!

¿Quieres formar parte de una de las cinco empresas más grandes de TI y procesos de negocios IT?

Necesitamos incorporar un/a Data Scientist para formar parte de un gran equipo de trabajo.

Funciones y tareas:

Aplicar técnicas de extracción de características para reducir la dimensionalidad y capturar la estructura subyacente de los datos.

Avanzar en el conocimiento de diferentes modelos de clasificación, regresión y clustering

Mejoras y refactorización de código Python para poder productivicar los desarrollos realizados

Casos de uso de IA y IA generativa

Requisitos necesarios:

Mas de 2 años de experiencia en posiciones de analítica avanzada

Codificación con programación moderna o lenguaje de secuencias de comandos (Python y R).

Experiencia en el uso de herramientas de ciencia de datos como Knime, Dataiku, SageMaker o similar

Experiencia aplicando a conjuntos de datos algoritmos de clasificación, regresión y clustering.

Habilidades en el... ámbito de la visualización de datos con librería de Python o herramientas de visualización como Power BI o Tableau

Experiencia en la aplicación de modelos de procesamiento del lenguaje natural (NLP)

Habilidades avanzadas en consultas SQL.

Conocimiento de los fundamentos de la gestión de datos y los principios de almacenamiento de datos

Requisitos deseables:

Experiencia en bases de datos con varios RDBMS, como MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.

Desarrollo de ETLs para el tratamiento de datos

Experiencia en la creación de productos de datos de manera incremental, integrando y administrando grandes conjuntos de datos de múltiples fuentes.

jobs_results.description:
¡Atención, amante de la tecnología! Si eres una persona curiosa, creativa y con pasión por la innovación, ¡esta oportunidad es para ti!

En nuestro equipo, buscamos mentes inquietas como la tuya, dispuestas a formar parte de Comunidades tecnológicas donde construir conjuntamente. ¡Prepárate para un viaje emocionante!

Pero, antes de nada, ¿nos presentamos?

Somos atmira, un ecosistema de interacción centrado en las personas. Nuestro objetivo es ayudarte a desarrollarte tanto personal como profesionalmente. A través de nuestro Club, podrás relacionarte, vivir experiencias profesionales y alcanzar tus metas.

En atmira, tú eres el protagonista y tienes el poder de explorar tu potencial con #Icouldbe.

Y ahora que ya nos conocemos un poco más… ¿A qué te vas a dedicar?

Trabajarás en un proyecto junto a uno de nuestros clientes donde podrás realizar desarrollos y dar apoyo técnico al mismo.

Tus funciones principales serán las siguientes:
• Diseño y ejecución de proyectos.
• Minería de... datos.
• Evaluación de casos de uso analíticos (viabilidad, diseño técnico, etc.).
• Creación de modelos basados en machine learning (regresión, clasificación y clusterización principalmente).
• Desarrollo de cuadros de mando para la explotación de los modelos.

¿Con qué tecnología trabajarás principalmente? Trabajarás con Python, PySpark, Spark, TensorFlow, Machine Learning, Deep Learning o Microsoft Azure (Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning).

¿Te resulta interesante? Aún tenemos mucho más que contarte:

🌱 Un fantástico equipo de personas que te ayudarán a desarrollarte y encontrar tu sitio dentro de una empresa dinámica, innovadora y ágil.

🏘️ Open Spaces, espacios abiertos al conocimiento que nos permiten facilitar la colaboración y una metodología de trabajo híbrida, flexible y sostenible.

💼 Metodología Smart Working: modelo híbrido de teletrabajo.

⏰ Horario flexible.

📅 Jornada intensiva viernes, julio y agosto.

🏖️ Vacaciones: 23 días.

🌟 Atmira Flex: ticket restaurant, abono de metro, seguro médico y guardería a tu disposición en nuestra plataforma de retribución flexible.

👟 Con nuestra Comunidad de Ambassadors siempre estarás activ_: deportes, aventura, planes por la ciudad…

💎¿Colegas del sector? con nuestro Programa de referenciad_s tráel_s a trabajar contigo y recibe un bonus por referenciarl_s.

💻 Dispondrás de una ayuda económica para el wifi si trabajas desde casa. Además de recibir el Home office pack en casa: silla, pantalla, teclado…

🍎 En la oficina siempre encontraras fruta a tu disposición.

🧠 ¿Te duele algo? No te preocupes, tenemos servicios a tu disposición para cuidar tu cuerpo y mente: fisio, talleres de bienestar y diferentes deportes que practicar en equipo.

Seguimos con la ronda de presentaciones, y ¿adivina qué?... ¡es tu turno! ¿te sumas a mover atmira? 🚀

• Experiencia en el uso de herramientas ML (Phyton, SQL, R,…)

Cómo será tu día a día…

Desarrollamos soluciones basadas en inteligencia artificial (IA) para impulsar la adopción de la IA en destacado grupo Bancario. Para ello, definimos la estrategia de IA, ofrecemos servicios y aplicaciones escalables y robustas en IA, centralizamos y divulgamos el conocimiento y buenas prácticas en IA, y exploramos nuevas tecnologías y tendencias manteniéndonos a la vanguardia del estado del arte.

jobs_results.title: CX360 Principal Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
About The Project

We're searching for a dynamic Lead Data Scientist focusing on rapid feature and algorithm implementation to spearhead Projects and Solution Accelerators for customer lifetime value (CLV) maximization in Retail/E-commerce. This role demands a deep understanding of retail/e-commerce dynamics and an agile approach to developing and deploying critical data models.

Today’s AI solutions targeting customer engagement are focused on click-through-rate optimization - raking systems, recommender systems, etc. This helps to optimize engagement at the moment, but this myopic view doesn’t consider long-term goals and customer retention. We are building a new layer for CLV optimization with reinforcement learning on top of existing solutions.

Duration: 6+ months

Stage: solution development from scratch

Objective + KPIs
• The solution is validated with 3+ new customers with CSI 100%
• 80% of AI engineering best practices are applied to the solution

Areas of Responsibility
•... AI solution architecture design and roadmap planning
• Engineering team leadership and performance management
• Communication with the customer on the development progress
• AI solution technical quality and performance management

Skills
• Proficiency in Python for quickly implementing machine learning algorithms
• Expertise with experimentation frameworks (SciPy, PyMC3, Spark MLlib) and analytics tools to quickly run robust tests and analyze results. The ability to design and analyze multivariate, non-standard experiments.
• Example:
• Leveraged Bayesian hierarchical models in PyMC3 to implement multivariate uplift modeling in Spark to test effectiveness of personalized email campaigns. Quantified incremental response rates.
• Built out an experimentation framework on SciPy and statsmodels to test the effects of recommendation algorithms, email timing, and coupon targeting on customer conversion rates. Used MANOVA to model the interactions.
• Developed an revenue optimization engine using contextual bandits algorithms with Spark MLlib. Evaluated performance through A/B testing framework on user randomization.
• Strong optimization algorithms abilities, including reinforcement learning, bandits, and uplift modeling.
• Reinforcement Learning - Ability to implement temporal difference learning, deep Q-learning, policy gradient methods to optimize long-term rewards. Critical for modeling customer interactions over time.
• Contextual Bandits - Expertise with bandit algorithms like upper confidence bound, LINUCB, and Thompson sampling to optimize actions based on user context. Key for personalization.
• Uplift Modeling - Proficiency in techniques like two-model, meta-learner uplift to identify causal impacts of interventions. Crucial for targeting high incremental value customers.
• Data Preprocessing and Engineering: Mastery in transforming complex retail/e-commerce datasets into model-ready formats. Example: Engineered features from raw transaction logs that improved a churn prediction model's accuracy by 20%.
• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Working efficiently with software engineers, data scientists, stakeholders, etc.
• Communication: Clear and concise communication, especially of complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Knowledge
